title: Two CTCF motifs impede cohesin-mediated DNA loop extrusion.
authors: Barth, Roman; Janissen, Richard; Muras, Laura; van der Torre, Jaco; Litos, Gabriele; van der Sluis, Eli; van den Berg, Ashmiani; Davidson, Iain F; Peters, Jan-Michael; Dekker, Cees
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子实验揭示CTCF NTR中两个基序YDF和KTYQR以不同机制协同阻碍cohesin介导的DNA环挤压，聚焦CTCF-DNA互作对基因组结构调控的动态机制，虽以实验为主但直接涉及TF-DNA结合与互作机理，对课题有重要参考价值。
abstract: Human cohesin extrudes DNA into loops and is positioned along the genome by stalling at the human CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) upon encountering its N-terminal region (NTR). The mechanism underlying this stalling, however, is unresolved. Using single-molecule assays that monitor DNA loop extrusion (LE) in the presence of NTR fragments, we identify two amino acid motifs, YDF and KTYQR, which hinder LE. KTYQR is found to completely block LE activity, while YDF hinders cohesin from completing LE step cycles and converts cohesin into a unidirectional extruder by strengthening the affinity of STAG1 to DNA. We thus identify two distinct NTR motifs that stall LE via different yet synergistic mechanisms, highlighting the multifaceted ways employed by CTCF to modulate LE to shape and regulate genomes.
abstract_zh: 人类cohesin将DNA挤压成环，并通过在其N端区域（NTR）处停滞于人类CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）而沿基因组定位。然而，这种停滞的潜在机制尚未解决。利用在存在NTR片段时监测DNA环挤压（LE）的单分子实验，我们识别出两个氨基酸基序，YDF和KTYQR，它们阻碍LE。发现KTYQR完全阻断LE活性，而YDF则阻碍cohesin完成LE步进循环，并通过增强STAG1与DNA的亲和力将cohesin转化为单向挤压器。因此，我们识别出两个不同的NTR基序，它们通过不同但协同的机制使LE停滞，突显了CTCF调节LE以塑造和调控基因组的多种方式。
